signature: ai.file.embedBatch(file :: STRING, provider :: STRING, configuration = {} :: MAP, tokenCountLimit = null :: INTEGER) :: (index :: INTEGER, resource :: STRING, vector :: VECTOR)
name: ai.file.embedBatch
description:
Embed a given file in batches of resources as vectors using the named provider.
The given file will be read, and if applicable, chunked into a list of resources which are then batch embedded.
If no chunking, the embedding will be done as if a list of a single item was provider,
if the file is chunked the the chunks will be provided in an ordered list and the procedure will return:
    * the corresponding 'index' within that LIST,
    * the original 'resource' element itself,
    * and the encoded 'vector'.

returnDescription.name: index
returnDescription.description: The index of the corresponding element in the input list.

returnDescription.name: resource
returnDescription.description: The name of the input resource.

returnDescription.name: vector
returnDescription.description: The generated vector embedding for the resource.

argumentDescription.name: configuration
argumentDescription.description: Provider specific configuration, use `CALL ai.text.embed.providers()` to find the configuration needed for each provider. You can specify additional vendor options by adding `vendorOptions` with a map of values that will be passed along in the request.

argumentDescription.name: tokenCountLimit
argumentDescription.description: The maximum token count limit for each chunk, if null, chunking will not be applied.

signature: ai.image.embedBatch(resources :: LIST<STRING>, provider :: STRING, configuration = {} :: MAP) :: (index :: INTEGER, resource :: STRING, vector :: VECTOR)
name: ai.image.embedBatch
description:
Encode a given batch of images as vectors using the named provider.
For each element in the given resource LIST this returns:
    * the corresponding 'index' within that LIST,
    * the resolved 'resource' element (base64 bytes),
    * and the encoded 'vector'.

returnDescription.name: index
returnDescription.description: The index of the corresponding element in the input list.

returnDescription.name: resource
returnDescription.description: The name of the input resource.

returnDescription.name: vector
returnDescription.description: The generated vector embedding for the resource.

argumentDescription.name: resources
argumentDescription.description: The images to transform into embeddings: base64-encoded image bytes, local file paths (file:///path/to/image), or remote URLs (http/https/ftp).

argumentDescription.name: configuration
argumentDescription.description: Provider specific configuration, use `CALL ai.image.embed.providers()` to find the configuration needed for each provider. You can specify additional vendor options by adding `vendorOptions` with a map of values that will be passed along in the request.
